p3:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p3:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p3:main.conclusion: E: qualitative: mule (2n=63) chromosomes from horse (n=32) and donkey (n=31) fail homologous pairing in meiosis I, preventing gamete formation

p4:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p4:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p4:main.conclusion: B: qualitative: uplift of the Isthmus of Panama separated Pacific and Atlantic populations, blocking gene flow (allopatric speciation)

p5:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p5:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p5:main.conclusion: D: qualitative: from broadest to narrowest (Domain > Kingdom > Phylum > Class > Order > Family > Genus > Species), Domain -> Phylum -> Order -> Genus preserves strict descending order

p6:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p6:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p6:main.conclusion: B: qualitative: (가) floral structure difference is mechanical isolation (prezygotic) and (다) F2 decline is hybrid breakdown (postzygotic)

p7:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p7:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p7:main.conclusion: D: exact: 2n=12 (n=6) -> 4n=24 (gamete 2n=12); 4n x 2n gives 3n=18 triploid with 3 sets of 6 chromosomes that cannot form 9 normal tetrads and is sterile

p8:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p8:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p8:main.conclusion: A: exact: 25% remaining = 2 half-lives (11,460 yr); 1 more half-life (5,730 yr) gives 3 half-lives = 17,190 yr total and 12.5% remaining

p9:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p9:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p9:main.conclusion: E: qualitative: (다) Paleozoic Era begins with Cambrian explosion and ends with Permian mass extinction; (라) Mesozoic Era ends with Cretaceous mass extinction

p10:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p10:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p10:main.conclusion: C: qualitative: eagle and bat forelimb bone arrangement is homologous from tetrapod ancestor, whereas functional flight wings evolved independently as analogous traits

p11:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p11:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p11:main.conclusion: A: qualitative: horse fossil record shows bush-like branching and extinct lineages, refuting linear orthogenetic progression

p12:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p12:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p12:main.conclusion: E: qualitative: rapid change in punctuated equilibrium is relative to geological time (thousands to tens of thousands of years), not single-generation transformation, and genetic change continues during stasis

p13:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p13:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p13:main.conclusion: B: qualitative: homeotic gene product (나) is a transcription factor regulating timing and location of target genes (다), so altered expression shifts body part placement

p14:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p14:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
p14:main.conclusion: C: qualitative: molecular phylogeny places (다) Fungi closer to (라) Animals than to Plants, while (가) Cyanobacteria (Bacteria) and (나) Archaea belong to different domains

p15:main.evidence: evidence/independent-8장-v3.md: p15:main independent derivation matches pack answer key.
